headline: CheapCart announces a sale
summary: 20% off CheapCart packages for two days.
details: CheapCart is running a two-day neighbourhood promotion. Look for the sale price on its shelves.

headline: Oats go viral
summary: Oat prices rise 50% across stores today.
details: An online trend has everyone buying rolled oats, so they cost more today. The trend doesn't make oats any healthier than they were yesterday.

headline: Verdant & Co. closes for maintenance
summary: The store is closed today. Pantry food is unaffected.
details: Verdant & Co. is closed for maintenance today. You can still cook with what's in your pantry, or shop at another store. It reopens tomorrow.

headline: The bistro makes local news
summary: More visitors expected, plus a Verdant & Co. promotion.
details: A local feature has put the bistro in the news, so more people may drop by over the next two days. Verdant & Co. is celebrating with 10% off.

headline: CheapCart closes for restocking
summary: CheapCart is closed today. Pantry food is unaffected.
details: CheapCart is closed for a full restock today. Cook with what's in your pantry, or shop at another store. It reopens tomorrow.
